page.overview:
Who is Rain Shine?

Rain Shine is a female Kirin who first appears in the season eight episode Sounds of Silence. She is the leader of the Kirin village in the Peaks of Peril.

Rain Shine first appears in Sounds of Silence after Applejack and Fluttershy arrive in the Kirin village. When Applejack wonders if any of the Kirin talk, Rain Shine points her in the direction of Autumn Blaze, who explains that Rain Shine ordered the Kirin to enter the Stream of Silence after vocal contention led to the destruction of their old village. Autumn Blaze found and took an antidote to reverse the stream's effects, leading Rain Shine to exile her from the village.

Later in the episode, when Rain Shine and the Kirin attempt to immerse Applejack and Fluttershy in the Stream of Silence, Autumn Blaze intervenes and ends up convincing them of the value of speech and expression. Once the Kirin's voices are restored through the antidote, Rain Shine thanks Autumn Blaze for her efforts in teaching them the error of their ways and invites her back to live in the village.

In The Ending of the End - Part 2, Rain Shine can briefly be seen among the allied creatures who appear to aid Twilight Sparkle and her friends in confronting Queen Chrysalis, Lord Tirek, and Cozy Glow.
